_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: John Hoole (1727-1803). Tasso's Jerusalem Delivered in heroic couplets (1763), in the 1803 Bensley printing (2 vols). PD. Pairs with Fairfax. Added 2026-10-02/03 by lane C (round 5) under the coordinator's standing instruction to choose further translator shelves; Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted in the relay burst.

hoole-jerusalem-delivered.scan_edition: T. Bensley for J. Johnson, 1803, 'eighth edition, with notes', 2 vols (UC copy), raw OCR; the printing still uses the long s, so the OCR reads s as f

_pending.hoole-orlando-furioso: Hoole's Ariosto (1783): only 18th-century long-s printings and incomplete Google sets of the 1807 edition found. Not fetched.

_name_words_note: Translator name(s) only: fetch_shelf.py treats these as the identity check (one must appear in the fetched text), so the original author's name is deliberately NOT listed.

_identity_checked.hoole-jerusalem-2: Title page reads 'translated from the Italian of Torquato Tasso, by John Hoole ... vol. II ... 1803', but OCR splits the name ('HO 0 L E'). Checked by eye 2026-10-02.

_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.
